description: 描述一天的生活，例如幾點起床、做哪些家事、休閒活動。包含：打掃、煮飯、散步、看電視、陪孫子等簡單活動。

sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: It was good. I got up at 7 o'clock.
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: What did you do after that?
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: I made breakfast for my family. Then I cleaned the living room.
sentences.zh: 我為家人做了早餐。然後我打掃了客廳。
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: Do you do housework every day?
sentences.tips: 描述習慣用頻率副詞：always 總是、usually 通常、often 常常、sometimes 有時，放在 be 動詞後或一般動詞前。

sentences.en: Yes, a little bit every day. In the afternoon, I went for a walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 是的，每天做一點。下午，我去公園散步了。
sentences.tips: 描述習慣用頻率副詞：always 總是、usually 通常、often 常常、sometimes 有時，放在 be 動詞後或一般動詞前。

sentences.en: That's nice. Did you watch TV later?
sentences.zh: 那很好。你後來看電視了嗎？
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: Yes, I watched the news. My grandchildren visited me in the evening. We played games.
sentences.zh: 是的，我看了新聞。我的孫子孫女晚上來看我。我們玩了遊戲。
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: That sounds like a very nice day.
sentences.zh: 聽起來是非常美好的一天。
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。
描述習慣用頻率副詞：always 總是、usually 通常、often 常常、sometimes 有時，放在 be 動詞後或一般動詞前。

sentences.en: I make coffee in the morning.
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: I clean the house every week.
sentences.tips: 描述家務時，sweep（掃）、mop（拖）、vacuum（吸）三個動詞對應不同清潔工具，注意區分。

sentences.en: I like to walk in the morning.
sentences.tips: 說休閒習慣時，I like to take walks 比 I like walking 更口語自然，兩者意思相同。

sentences.en: I cook dinner for my family.
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: Sometimes I go to the supermarket.
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。

sentences.en: I watch TV in the evening.
sentences.tips: 描述日常作息，加上 in the morning、after dinner 等時間副詞，句子會更完整自然。
預約說 make an appointment，也可說 book an appointment，兩者語意相同可互換。

sentences.en: I go to bed at 10 p.m.

vocabulary.example_en: I do housework in the morning.
She makes breakfast for her husband.
Let's go for a walk after dinner.

vocabulary.example_zh: 我的孫子孫女非常可愛。

vocabulary.example_en: I usually drink tea, not coffee.

grammar_highlights.title: 用時間順序描述一天：First... / Then... / After that...
grammar_highlights.description: 描述一天活動時，可以用 First（首先）、Then（然後）、After that（之後）來讓敘述更清楚。
grammar_highlights.example_en: First, I have breakfast. Then, I clean the kitchen.
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 首先，我吃早餐。然後，我打掃廚房。

grammar_highlights.title: 用 I usually... 表達習慣
grammar_highlights.description: 要表達經常或習慣做的事，可以在句子前面加上 I usually...（我通常...）。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I usually go to bed early.

grammar_highlights.title: 用簡單過去式說今天做的事
grammar_highlights.description: 要說今天已經完成的事，可以用動詞的過去式，如 got up, made, cleaned, watched。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I washed the car this morning.

multiple_choice.question: 下列哪一句英文的意思是「嗨，你今天過得怎麼樣？」？

options.en: It was good. I got up at 7 o'clock.
What did you do after that?
I made breakfast for my family. Then I cleaned the living room.
options.zh: 我為家人做了早餐。然後我打掃了客廳。
